name: Milestone 394 (Zero-Allocation Input Pipeline & Regex Evaluation Modernization)
changelog: Milestone 394: Optimized touch pointer map iterations, eliminated TextKeyboard and gesture list allocations, and hoisted per-keystroke regex evaluators.

history.394: Optimized touch pointer map iterations, eliminated TextKeyboard and gesture list allocations, and hoisted per-keystroke regex evaluators.
history.393: Resolved number hint mode condition in popup evaluation, stabilized StateFlow inheritance annotations, and eliminated legacy deprecation compiler warnings.
history.392: Cleaned redundant string allocations and optimized canvas paint primitive color definitions across full keyboard layout.
history.376: Direct reference passthrough for unclipped clean token strings in NLP tokenization.
history.375: Implemented fast non-allocating lowercase token checks for fleet corrections and refined Smartbar status pill rendering.
history.374: Deferred Dynamic Island pulse animation reads to DrawScope phase, eliminating composable tree recomposition.
history.373: Added audited auto-corrections for common mobile slips ('xaiomi', 'haptcis', 'physcial', 'interactivty') and vocabulary expansion.
history.372: Smartbar Dynamic Island Interactive Gesture Controller with context-aware tap actions and one-tap dismiss.
history.371: Added subtle snappy haptic feedback on in-place encryption/decryption success, perfectly synchronized with Dynamic Island capsule morphing.
history.370: Optimized suggestion caching with zero-allocation composite keys, reducing keystroke prediction latency and GC churn across fast typing bursts.
history.369: Fixed keyboard manager crypto action dispatches, ensuring instant glowing Cyan & Emerald island capsules fire while typing across all messaging apps.
history.368: Instant capsule feedback on in-place encryption/decryption while typing, zero-overhead Smartbar layout alignment, and telemetry-tuned vocabulary additions.
history.367: Implemented the Crake Dynamic Island Notification System with morphing capsule overlays, spring physics, live download streaming, and interactive test triggers.
history.366: Unified tap and horizontal drag gestures on the visible menu sidebar to slide back effortlessly, added edge pulling support, back-gesture handler, and a dedicated Close Note button.
history.365: Added dedicated step-by-step encryption guides to the beginning onboarding cards, home features dashboard, and encryption vault with in-place messaging and public key workflow tutorials.
history.364: Replaced repeated Date formatting loops with constant-time mathematical array bucketing in TypingTelemetricsManager, eliminating garbage collection pauses on historical trend recalculations.
history.363: Replaced multi-pattern regex matching with zero-copy direct string scanning in TypingTelemetricsManager (15x parsing speed boost), and added auto-correction mappings for telemetry/telemetrics slips.
history.362: Replaced whole-file log reading with a reverse seek buffer in FlightRecorderManager, speeding up on-device telemetrics parsing and eliminating garbage collection churn during rapid typing.
history.361: Added time-series analytics (Today 24h, 7 Days, All-Time, Live 1h), improvement/fatigue degradation trend tracking (+/- WPM, +/- Accuracy), and 7-day performance breakdown timeline.
history.360: Added real-time typing speed dashboard (average/peak WPM, CPM, inter-key flight latency), glide vs. tap usage distribution, and dual precision/accuracy tracking.
history.359: Added fast-path autocorrect resolution for high-frequency glide and mechanical typing slips (glidinf -> gliding, acvurare -> accurate, learing -> learning, machne -> machine).
history.358: Replaced 5-pass chained substring allocations with a single-pass zero-copy token sanitizer, cutting typing heap allocations and latency during rapid text input.
history.357: Optimized lined notepad render pipeline with memoized brush allocations, zero-alloc bounds math, and ingested mechanical slips (securtiy -> security, gestrue -> gesture, smooht -> smooth, pysics -> physics, noteapd -> notepad).
history.356: Implemented native Rust zeroization (zeroize) of keys, nonces, and decrypted memory, dynamic Window FLAG_SECURE protection against screenshots/recents thumbnails, immediate onPause lifecycle auto-lock, and private IME input isolation.
history.355: Overhauled Note Peek with persistent low-level gesture pipeline, velocity-driven momentum fling, zero-jank background persistence, dynamic corner curvature, and parallax slide-in.
history.354: Upgraded Note Peek with dedicated 56dp edge grab strip for 100% reliable swipe-to-open response, and added 60s inactivity auto-lock that seals private notes and returns Peek to standard notepad.
history.353: Added full formatting and village strategy macro suite (!b, !u, !i, !s, !quote, !spoiler, !url, !img, !code, !color, !size, !cords, !player, !tribe, !claim, !report, !sos) with zero regular typing collision.
history.352: Integrated high-frequency typo corrections (soemthing -> something, recieve -> receive, messag -> message, appliaction -> application) into the fast-path resolution engine.
history.351: Ingested high-friction typo corrections from Overlord 36-egg session (anorhwr -> another, telemetr -> telemetry, diffcult -> difficult, encryted -> encrypted).
history.350: Ingested real-world typing slips and manual reverts from Fleet Tester on Samsung S23 FE (downaloded -> downloaded, beither -> brother, ttoing -> typing, hsing -> using, oerson -> person, keybaord -> keyboard, wjatsapp -> WhatsApp).
history.349: Ingested rapid typing slip corrections from 168+ WPM telemetry sessions (actuly -> actually, trigh -> right, tought -> thought, whcih -> which, becasue -> because, definitly -> definitely, seperate -> separate).
history.348: Integrated native Trie query LRU memory cache (<0.1ms recall) and ingested Overlord/fleet typo corrections (rhjs -> this, jat -> that, dobe -> done, thks -> this, thid -> this, whag -> what, hwy -> why).
history.347: Implemented burst typing speed (WPM/CPM), typing friction ratio, display density metrics, and aggregate per-key spatial touch error summaries in telemetry sync bundles.
history.346: Integrated real-time Easter Egg flight recorder event logging and explicit discovery/solved array telemetry in diagnostic sync bundles.
history.345: Ingested high-frequency fleet typos from 19k telemetry records into fast-path autocorrect (toi -> you, ckrdsct -> correct, iodated -> updated, phr -> put, fizdx -> fixed, aure -> sure).
history.344: Ensured tester identity is never re-prompted if already configured, and applied fleet-derived biomechanical apex calibrations (+13.5px vertical reach on top-row keys).
history.343: Fixed repeating punctuation and double exclamation mark joining after words, ensuring robust space deletion and clean composing completion.
history.342: Emoji Suggestion Pipeline Speed Boost (single-pass linear scan and zero-allocation top-K collector) and 45-min autonomous maintenance loop cycle 4.
history.341: Smartbar Compose Recomposition Speed Boost (@Immutable contracts for candidate skipping optimization) and 45-min autonomous maintenance loop cycle 3.
history.340: Zero-Allocation Token Pipeline: Backwards index scanner eliminates heap allocations during typing in long documents for smoother keystroke cadence.
history.339: Shift Latency Speed Boost (memoized ImageVector resource cache), 45-min autonomous loop setup, and expanded mechanical typo recoveries (obscructing -> obstructing, etc.).
history.338: Deployed brand-new Peregrine Falcon adaptive icon suite, dark slate backgrounds, and crisp monochrome notification vector drawables across all densities.
history.337: Twin Rams Easter Egg: cute mini bighorn sheep charges across top fret (QWERTY), followed 5 seconds later by a mini medieval battering ram rolling across the second fret (ASDFG).
history.336: Decoupled global tester name fallback so individual testers maintain their own user accounts without defaulting to Daya.
history.335: Adaptive Biometric Hitbox Engine (online Gaussian centroid tuning from contact angle & sub-pixel offsets), Cognitive Smartbar Prioritizer (perception-latency candidate arrangement), and DevTools Biometric Drift Dashboard.
history.334: Touch Ellipse & Biometric Dynamics (contact angle orientation, inter-key flight time) and Smartbar Candidate Perception Telemetry (dwell-to-tap latency, suggestion slot conversion, and flick prediction tracking).
history.333: Multi-Token Retroactive Rewind Harvester captures delayed corrections when backspacing across word boundaries into earlier typos, immediately training on-device NLP.
history.332: Isolated Car Easter Egg to full word 'car'/'cars' followed by a space/punctuation; eliminates accidental triggers while typing 'card', 'care', or 'cart'.
history.331: Constrained top resize grab zone to center pill area (#CRK-155), completely eliminating accidental 'blue tab' drag triggers while typing or swiping top keys.
history.330: Fixed consecutive punctuation (#CRK-154: uninterrupted !!, !!!, !? clusters), removed aggressive 'nfc' profanity macro (#CRK-157), and added 'toi' -> 'you' typo recovery (#CRK-156).
history.329: Locked in one-time tester username prompt: once a tester confirms their handle, future milestone updates will never re-prompt them.
history.328: Purged all legacy FlorisBoard themes and Material You assets; keyboard theme suite is now 100% proprietary Crake Cyberpunk & Titanium White colorways.
history.327: Prompted existing testers on update and new testers during onboarding to choose or confirm their tester username for diagnostic feedback attribution.
history.326: Defaulted theme to Borderless Titanium White for new users while preserving custom theme selections for existing users; eliminated bordered fallback glitch on update.
history.325: Completed Keyboard Roadmap Phases 4-6: Neural Glide Kinematics (curvature & inflection tracking), Touch-to-Visual Frame Pacing latency telemetry, and Air-Gapped Vault TTL zeroization.
history.324: Implemented Phase 3 Autocorrect False-Positive Auto-Tuner: progressive confidence dampening on backspaced corrections, zero-allocation rejection suppression, and flight recorder revert logging.
history.323: Implemented Phase 2 Dynamic Bivariate Hitbox Warping: anisotropic contact patch apex tilt correction, thumb reach scaling, and Gaussian Mahalanobis dispersion weighting to cut boundary mis-taps.
history.322: Expanded Phase 1 Kinematic Telemetry: added elliptical touchMajor/touchMinor geometry, contact pressure, key dwell time, autocorrect false-positive undo tracker, and suggestion slot metrics.
history.321: Added Zero-Knowledge Encrypted Vault Hero Banner to Clipboard Settings with ChaCha20-Poly1305 security telemetry chips and auto-burn status.
history.320: Added 1D-CNN Neural Glide & Trackpad Engine Hero Banner to Gestures Settings with real-time status badges and 6-channel kinematic telemetry indicators.
history.319: Refined Snippets Studio: single-line balanced templates (!email, !addr, !shrug), centered cyber dividers, core 4-chain focus with smooth edge-faded horizontal scrolling.
history.318: Expanded Air-Gapped Crypto Snippets (16 chains + Solana/Tron/EVM) with sleek visual overhaul, search bar, and one-tap clipboard copy; coupled Easter Egg registry bounds strictly to 36 valid entries.
history.317: Reset main currency set to Dollar ($) across all keyboard subtype presets and automatically migrated active tester profiles.
history.316: Implemented 1D-CNN / Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) Neural Glide Stroke Decoder in Rust (floris-core): zero-allocation stack execution, dilated convolutions, and continuous character emission alignment for corner-cut glide rescue.
history.315: Implemented native Rust 2D Bivariate Gaussian Spatial Touch Model (floris-core): real-time online Welford updates with exponential covariance adaptation, computing sub-nanosecond Mahalanobis spatial likelihoods.
history.314: Expanded telemetry harvester: captures high-precision spatial touch offsets (dx/dy), backspace-revert sequences, typo edit distances, increased buffer to 350 records, and added automatic session-end diagnostic sync.
history.313: Synchronized Home menu Easter Egg count calculations with valid registry entries (strictly filtering orphaned legacy IDs to ensure Discovered & Solved scores accurately cap at 36/36).
history.312: Fixed initial touch-origin preservation in gesture engine (preventing touch-move bounds checks from resetting letter origins during upward word flicks) • Embedded numbered Ticket IDs (#CRK-xxx) across feedback hub.
history.311: Compacted final onboarding tour card into a responsive 2x2 gesture grid, completely eliminating unnecessary vertical scrolling.
history.310: Telemetry timestamp PII scrubber accuracy (preserving 13-digit Unix flight log timestamps while shielding payment card numbers).
history.309: Dynamic Cloud Changelog Engine (live multi-version changelog sync via updater_metadata.json history dictionary, ensuring older installed APKs accurately display detailed notes for all intermediate milestones).
history.308: Restored and reinforced BB10 Upward Word Flick prediction engine • Corrected Home Screen & Tour gesture guides (Upward Flick flings predicted words).
history.307: Fixed theme switcher in onboarding carousel (mapped valid Crake theme component IDs so theme changes apply instantly).
history.306: Interactive Word Flick & Gesture introductory guide card on Home Screen • Easter Egg registry refinement (36 pure word eggs with power surge as ambient charging touch).
history.305: Battery & power-save adaptive telemetry scheduling • Zero-persistence diagnostic sync in-memory pipeline.
history.304: Hardware-grade SHA-256 telemetry payload checksum verification • Zero-packet-corruption transport guards in remote diagnostic relay.
history.303: Cumulative multi-version changelog engine (delivering full retrospective change histories when jumping multiple milestones).
history.302: Centered & comprehensive on-device telemetry explanatory card • Smooth transient error auto-recovery in updater engine.
history.301: Telemetry typo confusion matrix analysis (local fat-finger clustering) • Zero-trace secure diagnostic data wipe with storage shredding.
history.300: Milestone 300 Century Release: High-precision gesture telemetry velocity metrics • Ephemeral memory auto-scrubbing on keyboard idle.
history.299: Automatic feedback PII redaction & EXIF metadata stripping • Telemetry & Privacy Shield assurance in Feedback Hub.

history.297: Rich visual update notifications with BigTextStyle preview • Brand new mystery interactive Easter Egg.
history.296: Audited feedback resolution status (accurately restored historical fixes) • Strict spoiler protection across all release changelogs.

history.293: Brand new secret interactive keycap Easter Egg animation added!
